crossRefs.note: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.
One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied.…
I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine.…

translations.web: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
translations.bsb: Why do I put myself at risk and take my life in my own hands?
translations.kjv: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
translations.asv: Wherefore should I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hand?
